title: Klippo Master Product-Specific Video Prompt Library — Expanded Edition
usage_notes: All curated prompt templates are stored in this version-controlled GitHub JSON library and loaded by Klippo; templates are not invented randomly at runtime.
Prompt generation is text-only. No uploaded image or AI image analysis is used. Product subtype and category are inferred from words in the supplied product name or the user's selected category.
Every prompt is a complete, copy-ready block of text with its own premium four-beat storyboard. Each concept has a distinct signature action, detail shot and closing composition.
No on-screen text, captions, added logos or watermarks. Each storyboard prompt is exactly 10 seconds, vertical 9:16.
For 20-second requests, Klippo delivers two separate complete 10-second prompt texts; Part 2 begins from Part 1's held final frame and uses a complementary action rather than repeating the opening.
Templates avoid unsupported specifications, benefits, ingredients, materials, accessories and performance claims.
External video generators may interpret prompts differently; Klippo stores and selects prompts but does not guarantee the output of external generators.
Expanded in version 1.1.0 with 285 additional curated concepts across all 19 categories. Existing prompt IDs and wording are preserved; new IDs use the v2 suffix.

prompts.prompt:
Create a 10-second vertical 9:16 product advertisement for the ring product name supplied by the user. This prompt is generated from text only; no uploaded image or AI image analysis is used. Do not invent materials, stones, engravings, certifications, price, benefits or packaging. STRICT OUTPUT RULES: exactly 10 seconds, vertical 9:16, one cohesive photorealistic product video, no on-screen text, no captions, no added logos, no watermark, no morphing, no floating objects or unrealistic transformations. Keep the product presentation consistent and finish with a clean hero frame. REAL-WORLD SCALE IS MANDATORY: preserve ordinary physical dimensions and proportions relative to hands, fingers, wrists, people, furniture and surroundings. A ring must remain finger-sized and must never become table-sized; achieve close-ups through macro camera framing, not by enlarging the physical object. Watches must fit wrists, phones must fit hands, and proportions must remain stable across shots. If exact dimensions are unknown, use realistic category-appropriate scale. Preserve the exact band shape, stone count and placement, setting, colour and visible details. Use realistic hand anatomy, natural contact, physically plausible reflections and consistent product geometry. HOOK + DEMONSTRATION + CTA ARE REQUIRED IN EVERY 10-SECOND SEGMENT: begin with a distinct product-specific spoken micro-hook in 0–2s, show one visible demonstration or verified benefit, and finish with a concise spoken CTA. For a connected Part 2, use a fresh continuation hook and a different CTA; never repeat Part 1 wording. If voiceover is enabled, follow the user's selected language: for Bahasa Melayu, use natural Bahasa Melayu Malaysia with native Malaysian pronunciation, rhythm and local vocabulary; Indonesian accent and Indonesian vocabulary are prohibited. For English, use natural conversational English with clear pronunciation. Keep each 10-second segment concise (normally about 18–22 words maximum, adjusted to language and delivery speed); vary suitable delivery styles such as cute, cheerful, friendly, humorous, calm, serious or confident. Do not invent product claims, benefits, discounts or guarantees. If voiceover is disabled, create the hook and CTA visually through an immediate product-specific reveal, a clear demonstration, and an inviting final product presentation or natural gesture. NEVER display hook/CTA as text; no captions, added logos or watermarks.

PREMIUM STORYBOARD — EXACTLY 10 SECONDS:
0–2s | Opening / true-scale ring reveal: Open on a natural adult hand wearing the ring on one finger, or display the ring on a small neutral jewellery stand. The ring must remain physically ring-sized and proportional to the finger; use macro framing, never enlarge the object.

2–6s | Signature action: The adult hand turns gently once to catch a natural highlight. Keep the ring fitted to the finger with unchanged band thickness, setting, visible stone placement and true proportions. No extra fingers, duplicate rings or added jewellery.

6–8s | True-scale macro detail: Use a camera macro close-up of only the visible band, stone or setting. Magnify the view through framing only; preserve the ring's physical dimensions and exact visible design. Do not invent stones, engravings or materials.

8–10s | Stable ring hero close: Return to a clear view of the same ring on the same adult finger or neutral stand. Keep the ring small relative to the hand, preserve all details and hold a clean final frame.

CINEMATOGRAPHY & CONTINUITY: Photoreal live-action product cinematography, natural skin texture, restrained highlights, realistic contact shadows, no warped fingers, no oversized jewellery, no fake sparkle effects and no changes to the ring design
